s0DC42E.name: Draw horizontal row of spikes
summary: Level object: row of spike tiles, Map16 $15A or $159 chosen by type.
Object byte [$59]: high nibble = type (index into DATA_0DC42C), low nibble = width-1. Start index in [$57].

s0DC44C.name: Data: vertical spike tiles
summary: Map16 $15B,$15C,$153 selected by the type nibble.

s0DC44F.name: Draw vertical column of spikes
summary: Level object: column of tiles drawn downward, Map16 $15B/$15C/$153 by type.
Object byte [$59]: high nibble = height-1, low nibble = type.

s0DC46F.name: Data: stone block wall tiles
summary: Left, middle and right column tile sets; each holds the top, middle and bottom row tile (Map16 $15D-$165).

s0DC478.name: Tileset objects: wall, ledge, spikes, pipe
summary: Contains five object draw routines that write Map16 tiles into the level buffer at [$6B]/[$57]:
stone block wall ($DC478, 3x3 tile set), castle ledge ($DC4C9), large spikes ($DC4EF), rock wall background ($DC58A)
and double-ended pipe ($DC5D8, walkable middle).
Parameters: [$57] = start index, [$59] = size/type byte, [$6B] = buffer pointer. Page 0/1 of Map16 is chosen by the two 'store page' helpers.

s0DC620.name: Map16 definitions: tileset page $0DC800
summary: $0DC620-$0DC7FF is $FF padding. From $0DC800: Map16 tiles $100-$1B1 for this tileset page (8 bytes each = TL,TR,BL,BR as chr,prop).
Shared by several tilesets through TilesetMAP16Loc (bank 04). Tiles $131-$18C are blank (all 00).

s0DCD90.name: Dispatch object for tileset 2 objects
summary: Looks up the object number in [$5A] (minus 1) and jumps through the long pointer table that follows.

PtrsLong0DCD9A.name: Object pointer 01: Water (Blue)
summary: Long pointer table (3 bytes per entry), indexed by object number - 1. Many entries are placeholders or share a routine;
many point at shared routines in this bank (CODE_0DA8C3 for single/repeating blocks, CODE_0DB3E3 for edges).

PtrsLong0DCE42.name: Object pointer 39: Vertical guide lines / vertical column

PtrsLong0DCE48.name: Object pointer 3B: Very steep guide lines

PtrsLong0DCE54.name: Large line guide circle quarters
summary: Last pointer entry (vertical log) followed by the 2x2 tile data for each large line-guide circle quarter and the routine that draws them.
Object byte: object number - $4D times 4 indexes DATA_0DCE57; places 2 rows of 2 tiles. Parameters: [$57] start index, [$59] object number.

s0DCE90.name: Data: small circle quarter tiles
summary: Map16 $076-$079 for the four quarters of a small line-guide circle.

s0DCE94.name: Draw small line guide circle quarter
summary: Writes a single Map16 tile ($076-$079 by object number - $51). Followed by ADDR_0DCEA6, unused canvas bit drawing Map16 $084/$085 stacked vertically.

s0DCEC0.name: Draw horizontal line guide end
summary: Writes Map16 $096 and $097 going down: end cap of a horizontal line guide.

s0DCEDA.name: Draw vertical line guide end
summary: Writes Map16 $098 and $099 going right: end cap of a vertical line guide.

s0DCEF2.name: Draw horizontal conveyor
summary: Row of Map16 $10C or $10D by type; low nibble of [$59] = width-1.

s0DCF10.name: Data: horizontal guide line tiles
summary: Map16 $092,$093 by type.

s0DCF12.name: Draw horizontal guide line
summary: Row of Map16 $092 or $093 by type; low nibble of [$59] = width-1.

s0DCF33.name: Draw vertical guide line, dispatch shape
summary: Vertical guide line / column going downward, followed by the dispatcher for slope-shaped guide lines (low nibble of [$59] = shape 0-5).

PtrsLong0DCF5C.name: Guide line slopes and dispatch
summary: Pointer table (6 shapes) and the four slope routines (normal left/right, steep left/right incl. ON/OFF variants) plus the very steep dispatcher.
Each routine draws one tile pair or tile per step and walks the buffer index diagonally, crossing 16x27-tile screen boundaries as needed (CODE_0DA987/CODE_0DA9D6/CODE_0DA9EF).
